prometheus.claim_boundary: Prometheus is in live validation. A forecast is a falsifiable, timestamped research assessment, not an official warning or emergency instruction. Mechanism-level scoring measures prospective predictive consistency; a hit does not prove causation and a miss does not automatically falsify the mechanism. Engines without a pre-declared testable policy contribute memory but do not generate speculative forecasts.
